text:
ellen: heads up — after last night's egress zero-trust rollout in us-west-4 we're seeing a spike in GPU warmup failures and healthcheck timeouts.
harry: confirmed. healthchecks failing to reach metrics-collector on 10.77.4.18:443. allocator logs: `ERR dial tcp 10.77.4.18:443: i/o timeout`
zoe: security pushed deny: outbound to 10.77.0.0/16 as default. collector lives in that block.
security: correct — deny baseline went live to reduce blast radius for internal logging endpoints. We flagged services we thought needed exceptions but missed gpu-healthchecks.
ops-bot: alert: gpu-warmup-health-fail_usw4 (count=28) severity=high
ellen: this is eating into reserved capacity. idle time rising rapidly. cost-ops, what's the burn?
cost-ops: preliminary: idle GPU minutes up 4x vs baseline; projected ~$6k/hr if not remediated.
harry: two immediate mitigations: 1) temporary egress allow for collector IPs (fast, timeboxed) 2) reroute healthchecks through control-plane egress-gw (compliant, slower).
zoe: prefer (2) long-term. For fast fix we need scoped egress rule limited to tag=warmpool and collector IPs, TTL 45m.
security: will approve timeboxed allow (45m) scoped to security group and IPs with audit note. Need PR + infra owner and PM signoff.
ellen: creating PR infra/hotfix/allow-collector-usw4. snippet attached:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "egress_allow_collector_warmpool" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.77.4.18/32"]
  description       = "TEMP allow warmpool -> metrics-collector (45m)"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.gpu_warmup.id
}
```
deploy-bot: apply started infra/hotfix/allow-collector-usw4 at 6120000060 by ellen
harry: staging canary (4 nodes) warmed after patch. increasing canary to 20. enable ALLOC_LOG_LEVEL=debug for these to capture any other TLS issues.
ops-bot: canary check: 4/4 warmed at 6120000078
ellen: rolling to 20 -> 60 nodes now. watching cost dashboard and SIEM alarms.
security: audit note: temporary egress exception approved (ellen/harry/zoe). TTL 45m. Must attach change request and include postmortem.
cost-ops: observed stabilization; idle minutes decreasing. keep an eye on billing alerts.
zoe: action item while patch live: schedule infra#4990 to implement control-plane egress-gateway for metrics and a whitelist sync with security. Also add e2e for warmup->collector path.
harry: once warmup stable, we'll remove rule and validate gateway route. rolling back in ~35m.
deploy-bot: destroy infra/hotfix/allow-collector-usw4 completed at 6120000120 by ellen
ops-bot: post-deploy check: warm-pool healthy, 0 warmup failures at 6120000125
ellen: postmortem summary: root cause = overly-broad deny in zero-trust rollout that didn't include metrics-collector. mitigation = scoped timeboxed allow. follow-ups: infra#4990 implement egress-gateway, security to publish exception runbook, add e2e warmup test.
zoe: adding owners to infra#4990 (harry/ellen) and security for the runbook. closing alert. thanks all :thumbsup:
